note: Kinetic campaigns and how the current-event publication policy applies to each (docs/CURRENT_EVENT_PUBLICATION_POLICY.md). Status is a curated fact with a dated basis, re-checked when a country is researched. Read by pipeline/build_systems.py and scripts/import_candidates.py. Since iteration 19 `system_states` classifies every Gulf system (ACTIVE_KINETIC_CAMPAIGN, RECENT_ENDED_CAMPAIGN, NO_ACTIVE_CAMPAIGN, UNCERTAIN); UNCERTAIN restricts exactly as ACTIVE does, and `policy_applied`, not `status`, is what withholds.

release_rule.text: Facility-specific restart, recovery or operating status for a record in a campaign is published only once the campaign is recorded as ended and 30 days have passed. While it is active the event itself is published; its facility status is not.

campaigns.name: Attacks on UAE energy facilities, 2026
campaigns.status_basis: Energy facilities in the UAE were reported attacked from March to May 2026. No attack on one was found for August to November 2026, but no end is reported and the wider war is described as ongoing in November 2026. Uncertain is treated as active.

campaigns.name: Attacks on Bahraini energy facilities, 2026
campaigns.status_basis: Energy facilities in Bahrain were reported attacked in March and April 2026. No attack on one was found for August to November 2026, but no end is reported and the wider war is described as ongoing in November 2026. Uncertain is treated as active.

campaigns.name: Attacks on energy facilities in Iraq, 2022 onward
campaigns.status_basis: Attacks on gas and oil fields in the Kurdistan Region are reported from 2022 onward, the most recent on 2026-11-08; attacks on oil fields in the south and north were reported in March and April 2026. No end is reported.

member_rule.from_basis: Starts at the window start, not at 2026: the series at the same sites runs from 2022 and one was reported attacked again in November 2026.

campaigns.name: Strikes on energy facilities in Iran, 2025 and 2026
campaigns.status_basis: Energy facilities in Iran were reported struck in March and April 2026, the war is described as ongoing in November 2026 and no ceasefire is in force.

member_rule.from_basis: Starts at the June 2025 strikes, not at 2026: sites struck in 2025 were reported struck again in 2026, so a 2025 record's recovery would be a 2026 target's status. A conservative choice; the 2025 war itself ended on 2025-06-24.

campaigns.name: Attacks on Kuwaiti energy facilities, 2026
campaigns.status_basis: Energy facilities in Kuwait were reported attacked repeatedly in March and April 2026 and once more in July 2026. No attack on one was found for August to November 2026, but no end is reported and the wider war is described as ongoing in November 2026. Uncertain is treated as active.

campaigns.name: Attacks on Omani energy facilities, 2026
campaigns.status_basis: Two attacks on fuel storage in Oman were reported in March 2026 and none since. That is thin for a campaign, but the war they belong to has no reported end, so the classification stays uncertain and uncertain is treated as active.

campaigns.name: Attacks on Qatari energy facilities, 2026
campaigns.status_basis: Gas facilities in Qatar were reported attacked in March 2026. No attack on an energy facility was found for April to November 2026, but no end is reported and the wider war is described as ongoing in November 2026. Uncertain is treated as active.

campaigns.name: Attacks on Saudi energy facilities, 2026
campaigns.status_basis: Attacks on Saudi energy facilities were reported from March to July 2026, and attacks on oil facilities were reported again in October 2026. No ceasefire or end is reported (status check of 2026-11-11).

also_covers.reason: Its own cause is unknown, but the site is a 2026 strike target (sa-2026-04-juaymah-processing-fires): its export status is that facility's status.

campaigns.name: Strikes on energy infrastructure in Russia, Belarus and Crimea, 2022 onward
campaigns.status_basis: Strikes continue to be reported (the theatre's own daily build).

policy_rule.text: Occurrence is published at administrative-region level as before. A recovery record for a campaign incident (restart, restoration, repair estimate or current status) is used for display, scoring and the build ledger only once its evidence is at least methodology/scoring.json campaign_publication.evidence_embargo_days old and any repair estimate it carries has run its course; until then the incident is scored on the modelled class horizon and the dossier says why. Recorded withheld records are counted, never named. A current build refuses to run with an embargoed record in the curated file, because the repository is published too.
policy_rule.differs_from_country_rule: Saudi Arabia keeps full withholding (no facility status until the campaign ends + 30 days, release_rule A). The theatre's index is built on recovery evidence, so it releases evidence once it is history instead; docs/OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DELAY_OPTIONS.md.
